June noun

classical

Cic. Att. 5.21.14: ante mēnsem Jūnium
Cic. Att. 6.2.6 (Lewis & Short)
Traupman 77

Jūnius, Jūnia, Jūnium

adjective, with mēnsis; also a masculine noun (sc. mēnsis)

of June; June

Kalendae, Nōnae, Īdūs Jūniae: the 1st, 5th and 13th. Jūniō alone also means “in June” (see month).

Examples

  • nam Taurus propter nivēs ante mēnsem Jūnium trānsīrī nōn potest

    for the Taurus mountains cannot be crossed before June because of the snowCic. Att. 5.21.14

See also month, May, July, summer.
